hero.heading: Alumni Success Stories
hero.subheading: Meet Culinary Academy's graduates who have built high-income careers in 5-star hotels globally and launched successful culinary startups.

stories.name: Rahim Ahmed
stories.quote: Culinary Academy's NSDA-accredited training was the turning point in my life. I went from having zero kitchen knowledge to working in a fast-paced 5-star international hotel in Doha. The focus on food safety (HACCP) and practical multitasking helped me excel from day one.
achievements: Secured international placement within 3 months of graduation
Promoted to Demi Chef de Partie within 1 year
Masters multi-cuisine production for 500+ guests daily

stories.name: Sumaiya Akhter
stories.quote: Culinary Academy didn't just teach me how to bake; they taught me the science behind culinary arts and how to run a business. Principal Dewan Ismail's entrepreneurship classes gave me the confidence to launch my own boutique patisserie which now employs six staff members.
achievements: Launched a profitable boutique patisserie in Dhaka
Employs 6 professional bakers & assistants
Features custom French pastry and artisanal breads

stories.name: Arif Hasan
stories.quote: The internship placement program at Culinary Academy is phenomenal. I did my three-month practical internship at The Westin and was offered a full-time position as Commis Chef immediately after graduation. The practical hands-on hours at Culinary Academy prepared me perfectly.
achievements: 100% conversion from Culinary Academy internship to full-time employment
Recognized as outstanding intern during his placement
Specializes in cold larder and modern fine-dining starters

stories.name: Tariqul Islam
stories.quote: Culinary Academy's 6-Month Diploma course provided the comprehensive business and technical training I needed. The industry partnerships are real, allowing me to start my career directly at InterContinental Dhaka.
achievements: Learned advanced kitchen management and menu engineering
Secured full-time role at InterContinental Dhaka
Specializes in traditional Bengali fusion and fine dining production

stories.name: Nusrat Jahan
stories.quote: The combination of chef skills and specialty barista training was exactly what the modern cafe market needed. Culinary Academy gave me hands-on practice with commercial espresso machines and menu pairing.
achievements: First female head barista at a premium Dhaka cafe
Designed signature mocktail and coffee pairing menus
Mentors junior baristas in latte art and roasting techniques

stories.name: Fahim Chowdhury
stories.quote: Studying at Culinary Academy opened doors globally for me. Their curriculum is strictly aligned with international ISO and HACCP food safety standards, which makes transitioning to a high-end luxury resort in Maldives seamless.
achievements: Recruited directly for Hilton Maldives resort placement
Aces food safety audits and temperature log management
Spearheaded Japanese-fusion live station operations

stories.name: Tanvir Rahman
stories.quote: The practical classes at Culinary Academy gave me the confidence to handle the pressure in a busy 5-star hotel kitchen. The training under expert mentors made my transition seamless.
achievements: Secured Radisson Blu placement immediately after graduation
Aces the high-volume Continental banquet operations
Recognized for outstanding hygiene log compliance

stories.name: Farhana Yeasmin
stories.quote: Baking is all about chemical precision. Culinary Academy taught me the exact science behind sourdoughs and French pastries, helping me lead the dessert section at The Westin.
achievements: Heads the French pastry & custom mousse section
Reduced dessert wastage by 15% using portion scaling
Awarded Star Performer of the Month in hospitality

stories.name: Imtiaz Ahmed
stories.quote: My dream was to work in Dubai. Culinary Academy's NSDA and ISO-HACCP certifications made my visa processing smooth, and the trade tests were easy due to Culinary Academy's rigorous practice labs.
achievements: Passed Dubai culinary trade test on first attempt
Promoted to Junior Sous Chef in under 2 years
Specializes in Mediterranean cuisine and seafood station management

stories.name: Sajjad Hossain
stories.quote: Running a cloud kitchen requires deep knowledge of food costing and inventory. Culinary Academy's entrepreneurship classes were critical in showing me how to maintain margins.
achievements: Manages operations of a multi-brand cloud kitchen in Dhaka
Optimized menu costing, achieving 35% profit margin
Supervises a team of 8 cooks and delivery managers

stories.name: Kamrul Hasan
stories.quote: The knife skills and classic sauce training at Culinary Academy are exactly what premium kitchens look for. I started as Commis and was promoted to CDP within 18 months.
achievements: Heads the Hot Kitchen section at Le Meridien
Trained in classic French mother sauces and stock reduction
Maintains strict ISO-22000 food safety standards daily

stories.name: Jannatul Fardous
stories.quote: Culinary Academy's hands-on training in fondant work and sugar craft allowed me to start my own custom cake business. I currently serve over 50 corporate orders monthly.
achievements: Founded a highly successful custom cake studio in Dhaka
Averages BDT 80,000+ monthly profit from home bakery
Specializes in complex 3D fondant structures & tier cakes

stories.name: Mahbub Alam
stories.quote: Culinary Academy's curriculum prepares you for global standards. Learning HACCP was key to passing the strict food safety interview for Hilton in Abu Dhabi.
achievements: Secured Abu Dhabi placement through Culinary Academy partner network
Works in premium international buffet and banquets
ISO-HACCP certified expert in cross-contamination prevention

stories.name: Rashedul Islam
stories.quote: The portion control and plating classes at Culinary Academy help me run a tight ship. I supervise the entire kitchen line, maintaining high consistency across all dishes.
achievements: Manages kitchen operations for a premium restaurant brand
Leads recipe standardization and new menu development
Ensures zero delay in dish turnaround during rush hours

stories.name: Sadia Afrin
stories.quote: Tasting and milk texturing were skills I perfected at Culinary Academy. The combo course makes you highly employable in premium coffee shops and lounges.
achievements: Heads the beverage development team at Tabaq
Designed a new seasonal mocktail menu that boosted sales by 20%
Specialist in advanced latte art and custom flavor profiling

stories.name: Nayeem Islam
stories.quote: Culinary Academy's focus on high-speed prep work and commercial kitchen layouts was the best preparation for managing high-volume cloud kitchen orders.
achievements: Coordinates operations for 4 virtual restaurant brands
Maintains food prep times under 12 minutes average
Strict compliance with municipal health & safety rules
